# Burg Children's Dentistry & Orthodontics

> A comprehensive pediatric dental and orthodontic practice in Central Utah offering comprehensive care from preventive dentistry to advanced orthodontic treatments for children, adolescents, and adults.

Burg Children's Dentistry & Orthodontics serves the Salt Lake City and Central Utah region with specialized pediatric dentistry services, orthodontic treatments including Invisalign and braces, and a dedicated surgical center for complex cases. The practice emphasizes patient education, flexible financing options, and insurance coverage to make quality dental care accessible to families.

## Orthodontics Services

- [Orthodontics](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics): Main orthodontics page featuring Invisalign and braces in Salt Lake City
- [Orthodontic Services](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics/services): Orthodontic services including Invisalign, Spark, and braces options
- [Orthodontics For All Ages](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics/orthodontics-for-all-ages): Orthodontics treatment options for children, adolescents, and adults
- [Early Childhood Orthodontics](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics/orthodontics-for-all-ages/early-childhood-orthodontics): Phase I orthodontics for early childhood bite correction and development
- [Adolescent Orthodontics](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics/orthodontics-for-all-ages/adolescent-orthodontics): Phase II orthodontics for adolescents with braces and clear aligners
- [Adult Orthodontics](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/orthodontics/orthodontics-for-all-ages/adult-orthodontics): Adult orthodontics with Invisalign and financing options available

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/pediatric-dentistry): Main pediatric dentistry services page with financing and insurance options

- [Restorative Services](https://burgchildrensdentistry.com/pediatric-dentistry/services/restorative-services): Restorative treatments including fillings, crowns, and emergency care
